description: The BER Research Tool gives researchers access to statistical data from Ireland's Building Energy Rating (BER) scheme, administered by the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland. A BER certificate states the annual primary energy use and carbon dioxide emissions for space heating, water heating, ventilation and lighting of a dwelling, and the tool covers all aspects of construction that affect a dwelling's energy performance. Search results can be downloaded as a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet, the full dataset can be downloaded as a zipped file in xls or csv format, and a user information guide and terms and conditions are provided. Coverage: rated dwellings in Ireland. Access: free search and full download. Licence: SEAI terms and conditions. Caveats: only dwellings with a BER appear, and ratings are calculated, not measured. Simulation uses are dwelling fabric, heating system and energy rating data for national housing stock and retrofit models. Related records: EP-Online, ADEME DPE and the England and Wales EPC register.
